snippet.title: Grand Larceny Longplay (Commodore 64 Game)
snippet.description:
- Grand Larceny Longplay (Commodore 64 Game) -

Don't get fooled by the length, unfortunately there's a loooooot of time to kill in this game... 

If you (understandably) don't want to wait, just skip from 8:28 to 30:36.
